title: Out of Sight, Not Out of Clues: Can Video LLMs Guess from Partial Evidence?
reasons: 摘要级证据不足以自动收录，保留材料等待补充

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce ClueProbe, a diagnostic benchmark to (1) separate perceiving evidence from judging sufficiency, and (2) validate our diagnosis via targeted fine-tuning.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: ClueProbe comprises 1,721 human-annotated questions across 598 natural videos, labeled Answerable, Guessable, or Unanswerable, alongside controlled perturbations altering wording or visual input.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating 10 open-source and proprietary Video LLMs reveals that failures stem from judgment rather than perception: models perceive the evidence yet lack graded sufficiency awareness, answering or refusing outright while rarely guessing from partial clues.
